output.title: Spacious 3-Bedroom Duplex with Panoramic City Views and Terrace in Cloche d'Or
output.description:
This newly built duplex apartment offers 180 m² of refined living space in Luxembourg's Cloche d'Or district. The voluminous living area features a double-height ceiling and floor-to-ceiling panoramic glazing that floods the interior with natural light while providing unobstructed views onto the adjacent new park. Engineered oak flooring adds warmth and continuity throughout the open-plan living and dining spaces.

The contemporary kitchen is seamlessly integrated with the living area, equipped with Siemens appliances, quartz countertops, and soft-close cabinetry, designed for both functionality and sociability. An internal staircase connects the two floors, enhancing the sense of space and flow within the apartment.

Upstairs, the master bedroom benefits from privacy and direct access to a wraparound terrace with wood decking, offering views over the nearby shopping centre and exposure to the evening sun. Two additional bedrooms, alongside two well-appointed bathrooms, provide ample accommodation. The property includes valuable amenities such as an elevator, parking, and a separate cellar for storage.

Situated in Cloche d'Or, Luxembourg’s evolving business and residential district, this home combines modern architecture with proximity to varied amenities, green spaces, and urban conveniences. This location is distinguished by contemporary office buildings, retail outlets, and parks, contributing to its reputation as a modern and comfortable urban quarter.

highlights.text: 180 m² duplex with double-height living room
Three bedrooms including upper-floor master with terrace access
Wraparound terrace with evening sun and city views
Panoramic views towards park and shopping centre
